title: narcissus citrinus
intro: Narcissus citrinus, commonly known as the Jonquil, is a perennial bulbous plant belonging to the Amaryllidaceae family, characterized by its sweetly fragrant flowers. The health benefits of Narcissus citrinus include its potential to reduce anxiety and stress due to its sedative properties, and it may also have antibacterial and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids such as galantamine, which has been shown to exhibit neuroprotective and anti-epileptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Narcissus citrinus also include homocholine, a compound with potential therapeutic applications in the treatment of Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative disorders.
